title: LOOK: Mr. & Ms. TUP system candidates partake in sashing ceremony and tree plantings
summary: Candidates from TUP Manila, TUP Taguig, TUP Cavite, and TUP Visayas gathered at the TUP Cavite Campus to receive their official sashes and participate in the tree planting activity last November 27, 2025.
body:
Candidates from TUP Manila, TUP Taguig, TUP Cavite, and TUP Visayas gathered at the TUP Cavite Campus to receive their official sashes and participate in the tree planting activity last November 27, 2025.

The sashing ceremony marked the official start of the Mr. & Ms. TUP System pageant, where candidates from all campuses came together to celebrate unity and environmental awareness.

The tree planting activity symbolizes the candidates' commitment to environmental sustainability and their role as ambassadors of the university.
author: The Philippine Artisan

title: ANNOUNCEMENT: OP approves first semester extension until January 10, 2026
summary: The Office of the President has approved the extension of the first semester academic calendar until January 10, 2026.
body:
The Office of the President has approved the extension of the first semester academic calendar until January 10, 2026.

This decision was made to ensure that students have adequate time to complete their academic requirements following recent disruptions to the academic calendar.

All students and faculty members are advised to take note of the adjusted schedules and deadlines.
author: The Philippine Artisan

title: TUP Manila celebrates newly licensed Civil Engineers
summary: The Technological University of the Philippines - Manila proudly celebrates its graduates who passed the recent Civil Engineering Licensure Examination.
body:
The Technological University of the Philippines - Manila proudly celebrates its graduates who passed the recent Civil Engineering Licensure Examination.

The university extends its warmest congratulations to all the new Civil Engineers who have brought honor to their alma mater.

This achievement reflects the quality of education and training provided by the College of Engineering.
author: The Philippine Artisan

title: 9th ADFA Sportsfest concludes at TUPM Covered Court
summary: The 9th Architecture and Fine Arts Sportsfest has successfully concluded with exciting competitions held at the TUP Manila Covered Court.
body:
The 9th Architecture and Fine Arts Sportsfest has successfully concluded with exciting competitions held at the TUP Manila Covered Court.

Students from the College of Architecture and Fine Arts showcased their athletic prowess in various sporting events.

The event fostered camaraderie and healthy competition among the students while promoting physical fitness and sportsmanship.
author: The Philippine Artisan
